Build record SCI-MAP-R02-DOCUMENT-BUILD/candidate-build-03
This document explains the map estimator, its response and uncertainty, the meaning of support
and validity, and the scope of observation coaddition for TolTEC scientists. The separate formal
contract remains the normative authority for the 52 requirements, 25 predictions, exact states,
provenance, and conformance procedure.
Scientiﬁc owner: Grant Wilson

Executive summary and current status
For a map pixel p, SCI-MAP forms the coeﬃcient-weighted average

using only realized PTC samples that are available under PTC’s declared identity and scope, have valid
ALIGN/AST coordinates, and pass MAP’s admission conditions. Here Gpi describes how sample i is placed
in its unique containing pixel, and γi is the exact PTC-owner-selected MAP-facing coeﬃcient. The admitted
Registry contains the uniform family SCI-PTC:uniform_constant@draft-0.1, with exact dimensionless γi = 1 , but
Registry presence and MAP permission do not select or realize it. A numerical route requires explicit selection,
complete PTC publication, exact target/payload/occurrence association, a requested, applicable, eligible, realized
SCI-PTC:uniform_coefficient_handoff@draft-0.1 decision, independent MAP admission, and MAP ﬁnite-positive clas-

measurements of zero sky brightness.

where the named v0.2 uniform family sets dimensionless uop = 1 for every admitted observation row. This is equal-
observation averaging, not precision. An observation bundle is admitted atomically: its signal, coordinates, response,
uncertainty, validity, and provenance must be mutually compatible before any of its valid pixels contribute. Pixel-level
support then determines where the admitted observation contributes.
Both equations are linear only conditional on ﬁxed sample and detector membership, projection, coeﬃcients, support
policy, response state, geometry/WCS, calibration, and upstream processing. If any of those states is estimated from
the same data, unconditional bias or covariance requires a joint model or resampling result.
Intended scientiﬁc estimator Positive-coeﬃcient ordinary map and compatible common-grid observation
coadd, Equations ( 1)–(2).
Upstream input status MAP always consumes a realized positive-rank PTC r0.5 product; there is no
CAL fallback, PTC-disabled MAP route, or inferred no-op PTC product.
The admitted uniform family can ﬁll the coeﬃcient slot only through explicit
selection and its complete exact handoﬀ. The approved ﬁnite-nonnegative
coverage_cut policy supplies no universal value or mode default.

The exact MAP lifecycle is requested, effective, observation_resolved, applied, realized, in that
order. requested is immutable accepted intent. effective is its supported executable interpretation.
observation_resolved means every observation-speciﬁc parent, coeﬃcient, proﬁle, geometry, mapping, pa-
rameter, support rule, output role, and persistence decision is concrete or typed unavailable. applied binds the exact
resolved operation and parameter state to the invocation or commitment of one execution attempt. realized binds
the immutable resulting accumulators, products, statuses, failures, and provenance that were actually produced. A
stop before application has neither an applied nor a realized record. An applied attempt that terminates before
output realization retains its applied-attempt identity and exact terminal failure but creates no realized product.

The MAP plan, coeﬃcient selection/application, projection, support policy, output/coadd plan, response/covariance request,
product role, and coverage_cut use this same ordering. Each parameter stage binds its exact value and provenance; a completed
realization contains all ﬁve stages, while an earlier stop contains only stages actually reached.
The MAP lifecycle does not replace the independently named PTC/V AL handoﬀ axes requested/not_requested,
applicable/inapplicable/applicability_unknown, eligible/ineligible/decision_unavailable, and

SCI-MAP v0.2 – Science-Team Rationale r0.2 CANDIDATE
realized/incomplete/failed/not_produced. It also does not replace the ECS requirement-result vocabu-
lary or evidence- artifact realization state. In particular, a MAP parameter’s resolved or applied value may be
checked before application or bound after application; its realized value is never a prerequisite for a pre-application
check.
Resolution, application, and realization are distinct. Pre-application validation examines the exact observation_
resolved parameter and proﬁle state. Application binds that resolved state to one attempt. A later realized record
binds what that attempt actually produced; it cannot be used retroactively as the prerequisite that authorized the
attempt.

1 What SCI-MAP estimates
SCI-MAP estimates a map-domain average of the realized PTC-transformed calibrated-x-derived nonpolarimetric
total-intensity-equivalent quantity zi = Z PTC
i . Neither mJy/beam nor a STOKES token promotes it to Stokes I. It
does not estimate unconvolved sky truth. The physical meaning of the result is therefore inherited from the complete
upstream CAL-to-PTC chain: what the ordinary xs sample represents, how it was calibrated and transformed, what
sky coordinate it has, and whether the required PTC product exists under its declared producer-local validity.
The numerical signal scale is the declared top-of-atmosphere, point-source-equivalent mJy beam− 1 convention inherited
from SCI-CAL with the exact originating ﬁxed-nominal-beam/template identity. MAP does not create absolute
calibration, choose a beam convention, or complete an unresolved broadband photometric deﬁnition. A numerical
map may consequently exist while literal point-source-peak interpretation remains unavailable because the response
for the declared processing chain is incomplete. The same caution applies to extended-source ﬁdelity, integrated ﬂux,
and absolute oﬀsets.
For one exact frozen upstream and MAP state, the linear response is the ﬁxed-state sky-to-PTC operator followed
once by the map operator. Writing the selected processed-sample vector as z = (zi),
AMAP,Π ≡ Aout = D− 1
Q,outJoutGΩ , ˆm = AMAP,Π z, R ﬁxed,Θ = AMAP,Π Hﬁxed,Θ , (3)
where the one MAP operator binds the admitted PTC-sample input domain, support-authorized output rows, co-
eﬃcient generation, one-hot projection, support policy, WCS/grid, parents, and lifecycle generation, while Hﬁxed,Θ
binds source domain, processed-sample codomain, units, parent, membership, support, coeﬃcient state, and response
basis. Preserving a constant sample vector does not prove preservation of a constant sky mode: an upstream baseline,
common-mode removal, or ﬁlter may already have removed it.
A stored kernel is a ﬁxed-state realized response only when its template, sample-domain parent, and processing lineage
prove Equation ( 3). Otherwise it is a tracer or has an explicit limited or unavailable status. That state does not
invalidate the numerical map or prohibit later analysis; it only limits the claims made by the original bundle. A later
simulated response or response-corrected map is a new versioned product bound to the original MAP product and
processing identity.

2 From samples to pixels
An occurrence i is not merely time and detector. It binds the observation, detector occurrence and UID,
stable RTC output sample n, exact PTC product/application generation, segment, and array/network/group.
Time is an attribute; input-column, row, and container positions are locators. The AST coordinate is exactly
SCI-AST:rtc_output_grid_coordinates@1 for the same n and parent chain. MAP never joins signal and coordinate by
time, row, cardinality, or numerical coordinate equality.
MAP owns SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1. A ﬁnite coordinate inside the target extent belongs to the unique pixel
whose cell contains it under half-open lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive bounds. There Gpi = 1 ; it is zero for every
other pixel. An internal upper edge belongs to the adjacent cell, while the outer upper boundary and every out-of-
grid coordinate contribute nowhere. Fractional projection is deferred until a complete kernel, support, normalization,
conservation, boundary, response, and covariance family is separately authorized. AST may materialize G, but the
artifact must bind both the AST coordinate parent and the exact MAP plan.
PTC owns the MAP-facing coeﬃcient γi. Frozen PTC r0.5 left its PTC-OD-010 family slot open; the later admitted
uniform authority ﬁlls one allowed slot with the exact dimensionless value γi = 1 . The family is usable only after
explicit selection, complete atomic PTC publication, exact target/payload/occurrence association, MAP permission,
and a requested, applicable, eligible, realized named handoﬀ under the compatible source binding. Registry presence
alone selects or realizes nothing, and MAP does not infer unity, loading, sensitivity, scatter, or inverse variance as
a fallback. A later coeﬃcient generation does not modify an earlier transformed product, and cross-generation use
needs an explicit compatibility decision. Coeﬃcient availability establishes the family and generation, index/broadcast
relation, transformed-product compatibility, readable payload presence, typed state, and cause; it does not claim
ﬁniteness. MAP alone classiﬁes an authorized payload as ﬁnite strictly positive, exact zero, negative ﬁnite, non-ﬁnite,
or unrepresentable.
The representation-independent handoﬀ is SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP_BOUNDARY v0.2-draft.1/r0.4 . MAP owns the occurrence-
level policy SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2; the exact manifest-bound SCI-V AL Registry revision binds it and V AL
Core evaluates it. The policy requires the exact PTC output-retention permission and preserved ancestry, excludes di-
rect synthesized/replaced representatives and unresolved required facts for this use, carries inherited inﬂuence without
turning it into a universal veto, and records response and uncertainty roles. Pixel placement and ﬁnal contribution
remain MAP estimator actions.
For an exact compatible selected coeﬃcient family the eﬀective contribution is Gpiγi. For the admitted uniform family
this becomes Gpi only after complete PTC publication, exact association, the four-axis handoﬀ, separate MAP admis-
sion, and MAP ﬁnite-positive classiﬁcation; the literal value one is not a fallback. Membership is the conjunction of ten
separately typed Boolean pass predicates derived from ten retained typed gate records: transformed-signal availability;
PTC output retention; coeﬃcient availability; PTC coeﬃcient/QC proposition; MAP upstream admission; AST coor-
dinate validity; ﬁnite transformed signal; ﬁnite positive coeﬃcient; admitted projection/boundary; and MAP-local con-
tribution plus required companions. Unknown, conﬂict, ineligible, unavailable, invalid, and not-requested all project
to estimator nonmembership where applicable while their full T/F/U/C or request/applicability/eligibility/realization
record, immutable reason, causes, provenance, and failure scope remain intact. For every gate with named request,
applicability, eligibility, and realization ﬁelds, only requested/applicable/eligible/realized passes. The PTC coeﬃ-
cient/QC pass says only that this ﬁeld combination holds under the exact PTC-owned coeﬃcient/QC proﬁle; it
cannot grant or rescue MAP admission. Evaluation is ordered: structural binding; safe retrieval and classiﬁcation of
only structurally admitted zi and γi; coordinate, placement, and companion gates; membership; then accumulation.
All gates pass before payload arithmetic. The payload is never screened by multiplication with a numeric zero mask.
MAP then accumulates

The numerator is not yet a sky estimate, and the denominator is a gridding normalization by default. Division occurs
only where the adopted support policy permits a scientiﬁc map value.
3 Projection, response, and removed modes
The one-hot family closes the initial Gpi route without making a fractional-kernel claim. It also keeps geometry
distinct from eligibility: AST-geometric incidence can exist when the PTC signal is unavailable; MAP-route-candidate
incidence additionally requires the realized route and upstream admission; estimator contribution adds every remaining

numerical and MAP-local gate.

family uses Equation ( 3) with every upstream and MAP choice frozen. The two full-procedure families are deﬁned by
the shared equations:

A numerical full-procedure diﬀerence is deﬁned only by a complete immutable comparison-space record. The record
binds baseline and perturbed product identities; scientiﬁc quantity and unit; occurrence or MAP output-row identities;
source and target frame/WCS; additive reference, gauge, and null- space state; baseline and perturbed support;
coeﬃcient and response basis; one exact common comparison domain; an exact map from each result into that
domain; explicit treatment of rows present in only one result; perturbation amplitude, sign, side, location, source
state, and normalization; ﬁnite- diﬀerence convention; state-transition record; and numerical availability with cause.
It authorizes no implicit zero ﬁll, union-domain sentinel, support intersection, coordinate-nearest or same-shape/row-
position association, interpolation, reprojection, or gauge alignment. Without the complete authorized record the
numerical diﬀerence is unavailable, or the result is only a separately typed state transition/discontinuity. ∆ SPTC-FP
never establishes subtractability by itself.
Thus two arrays are never subtracted merely because both procedures produced them. The parameter α binds
amplitude, sign, perturbation side, source state, location, normalization, domain, and every family parameter. The
separate ∆ SPTC-FP records changes in masks, groups, rank, loading subspace, classiﬁcations, coeﬃcient state, stop
cause, and support, but does not prove the payloads subtractable. Holding MAP state ﬁxed still requires exact
baseline/perturbed row identities and maps into common PTC and MAP comparison domains. Re-resolving MAP
can change Π 0, Π +, membership, and Sout; exact common grid and row maps are prerequisites to its numerical
diﬀerence. The name whole-chain is reserved for a separately authorized RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP rerun from
exact immutable parents; that response is unavailable and not claimed here.
The realized MAP operator AMAP,Π itself is always known and disclosed for a valid MAP product. Its exact PTC-
sample domain, support-row codomain, membership, one-hot projection, selected coeﬃcient generation, support policy,
WCS/grid, parents, and lifecycle are the MAP-local response statement. This disclosure remains meaningful when
the upstream-conditioned operator or procedure response is limited or unavailable; it is not a fabricated upstream or
whole-chain response.
A realized PTC-grid companion starts at MAP and receives the ﬁxed MAP operator exactly once. If any signal
member lacks a required exact companion, MAP keeps the complete signal membership and reports response limited
or unavailable; it does not construct a smaller hidden subset.
The PTC nonrestored additive reference λ, ﬁtted correlated removed component ˆUcorr, total removed component
Utotal,Θ , realized removed-subspace identity, ﬁxed-state null space, and any full-procedure invariant/unidentiﬁable
modes are separate facts. They are not automatically residual bias. The ﬁxed-state perturbation statement is
Equation ( 3); v0.2/r0.2 makes no unnamed µ0 or residual conditional-bias claim.

4 Weights and uncertainty
For ﬁxed upstream and map state, uncertainty propagates through the same map operator as the signal:
Cm = AN AT, (9)
where N is the declared PTC-domain processed-sample noise covariance when it is available for the asserted do-
main. Equation ( 9) retains cross-pixel terms created by shared samples and any correlations already present in the
timestream.
These quantities answer diﬀerent questions:
1. Q: the gridding denominator that normalizes the map;
2. a formal marginal inverse variance: valid only under its stated coeﬃcient and covariance assumptions;
3. the full conditional map covariance or precision, including correlated pixels when available; and
4. NOI’s exact conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment and conditional scale;
5. NOI standardized signal, with only its exact conditional-scale claim; and
6. any future calibrated-signiﬁcance method, which requires separate authority and remains unavailable here.
SCI-NOI owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty, conditional-scale, and standardization methods
and products. Any physical- noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness, signiﬁcance, probability, false-rate,
completeness, purity, or catalogue interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains unavailable
by default. MAP therefore keeps Q normalization, formal conditional precision, complete conditional covariance, the
NOI conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment, the NOI standardized signal, and
any future calibrated-signiﬁcance method as distinct identities and claims.
The base/unﬁltered MAP bundle reports what uncertainty or covariance information it actually provides, its mean-
ing, domain, assumptions, and limitations, and whether fuller information is persisted, recoverable from lineage,
summarized, incomplete, or unavailable. Missing correlations and nuisance terms are not zeros. Normalization, hits,
exposure, and diagnostic weight are not covariance. Absence of a complete covariance model neither invalidates the
map nor prohibits later analysis. A later covariance estimate is a new versioned product bound to the original map
and processing identity.
The distinction is especially important when sample membership, weights, projection, response, or support is estimated
from the same observation. The linear equations remain useful conditional descriptions, but they do not include
selection uncertainty. A joint model, resampling study, or other separately justiﬁed treatment is needed for an
unconditional statement.

The formal contract keeps the following facts separate. For science users they answer the following questions:

Hits are not validity, exposure is not precision, and positive normalization is not suﬃcient for ﬁnal validity. A
rectangular FITS image may contain storage values outside the scientiﬁc domain; the explicit support and validity
products determine which pixels are measurements. Unsupported pixels are unavailable, not zero sky.
Exposure begins with ALIGN-owned eacq and evo, measured in seconds on stable original occurrences. RTC,
CAL, and PTC preserve those facts, lineage, and causes. MAP deduplicates by observation, detector occur-
rence/UID, stable original/native occurrence, stable ALIGN slot, and ALIGN mapping generation. Under
SCI-AST_TO_SCI-MAP_ORIGINAL_FOOTPRINT_COORDINATE v0.1/r0.1 , it places each positive- evo original exactly once using that
original’s own AST ALIGN-grid direction/tangent/continuous-pixel parent in the exact target MAP WCS and the
one-hot half-open rule. Geometry/pointing realization, frame, coordinate validity, boundary state, parent, and
version are part of the identity. A descendant RTC-output coordinate is never substituted.
This is deliberately diﬀerent from causal inﬂuence. One original may inﬂuence several RTC/PTC outputs at diﬀerent
map pixels; the inﬂuence graph is retained, but its edges neither relocate nor duplicate physical seconds. Upstream-
eligible exposure uses originals ancestral to route candidates; retained exposure restricts the original population to
ancestors of admitted MAP outputs. Under one-hot placement, one original occupies at most one pixel, or none after
boundary loss. Coadded exposure unions observation-scoped original identities after atomic admission. Replacement,
synthesis, donor reuse, overlapping ﬁlters, decimation, duration, cadence, sample count, hits, Q, γ, and formal precision
cannot create or reconstruct exposure. Missing original lineage or own-coordinate authority makes the exposure role
unavailable. These products map unique original acquisition footprints; they are not complete temporal support,
eﬀective map integration time, precision, or normalized-map inﬂuence. Causal inﬂuence and representative RTC
occurrence are published separately.
Approved operational two-threshold policy . A lower threshold permits numerically safe normalization; a stricter
threshold deﬁnes the adopted science region. Both are scaled from an order statistic of the ﬁnite positive normalizations
in a declared map population. This is adopted policy, not a law of mapmaking or a proof of exposure, precision,
signiﬁcance, completeness, response, noise quality, or physical optimality.
Because the reference normalization is computed from a declared population, changing the map extent or population
Science-team circulation | CANDIDATE Page 8

SCI-MAP v0.2 – Science-Team Rationale r0.2 CANDIDATE
can change the science mask even when the local samples near a particular pixel are unchanged. That global behavior
must be justiﬁed and validated for the intended use.
The formal equations compare Qp with Q⋆c/ 10 and Q⋆c. The dimensionless scalar c = coverage_cut follows requested,
eﬀective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized stages. Pre-application validation checks the exact resolved
value; application binds it to one attempt, and realization records only what that attempt produced. It is ﬁnite and
nonnegative. Exact zero requests no relative cut: both relative thresholds are zero, while each row still requires its
own ﬁnite strictly-positive Qp. Values 0 < c ≤ 1 are the ordinary recommended range. A value above one is admissible
only when the independently authorized, same-value and same-scope Boolean plan fact coverage_cut_above_one_
override_requested is true; the number cannot authorize itself and may intentionally leave science support empty.
That record binds request identity, authorized owner/proﬁle, scope, each reached lifecycle stage, exact value, cause,
and provenance. A negative, non-ﬁnite, missing, or unrepresentable value fails before support rows are constructed,
application begins, or a required product is mutated. A completed realization retains all ﬁve stages; an earlier stop
has no future-stage placeholder. Neither this contract nor the admitted uniform coeﬃcient family supplies a universal
numerical or mode default.
Both comparisons are inclusive and retain the inherited exact population and order statistic. Thus a row exactly at
either threshold is included in that support plane. An empty policy population gives Q⋆ = 0 but creates no supported
row without ﬁnite positive normalization.
Science-team circulation | CANDIDATE Page 9

SCI-MAP v0.2 – Science-Team Rationale r0.2 CANDIDATE
6 Observation coaddition
V0.2 combines observation maps only when they represent the same declared quantity on one compatible pixel grid.
Each observation ﬁrst exists as a complete immutable logical bundle: signal, normalization, MAP-local operator,
upstream-conditioned response state, covariance status, exposure, support, validity, WCS, lifecycle, identity, and
provenance are checked together. Physical persistence is controlled by the eﬀective output plan. A conforming in-
memory bundle and its faithfully persisted form have identical admission, scientiﬁc identity, and arithmetic. A later
coadd-only entry may read persisted conforming bundles without rerunning upstream processing. Every plan-required
publication still completes or fails, and MAP does not waive PTC’s own required-publication obligations.
The six independently requestable product roles are SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:response_bearing_
observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1, SCI-MAP:response_bearing_coadd@1,
and SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1. Every request has its own immutable identity, parent set, ordered MAP
lifecycle, result, and failure scope. A stronger role is a new product over the exact base parent; it does not rewrite
that parent’s signal membership, response/covariance status, validity, or provenance.

The target common grid may be requested and ﬁxed before observation-map construction. The permitted placement is
then exact centered-integer embedding. A smaller map may sit inside a larger common grid only when each dimension
diﬀers by a nonnegative even number of pixels; half the diﬀerence is the integer oﬀset. The shifted reference pixel
must identify the same world coordinate. An odd shape diﬀerence is incompatible and the complete observation is

rejected. There is no fractional shift, post-hoc pad, interpolation, reprojection, mosaicking, or implicit recentering in
this ordinary branch. A later crop is a new row-selected product with its own identity, parent, and lineage; it cannot
relabel its parent or make that parent retrospectively compatible.

This restriction is the declared scope of the ordinary v0.2 coadd. It deﬁnes the approved preconstruction target-grid
request and exact embedding, while leaving fractional shifting, resampling, interpolation, reprojection, and mosaicking
to a separately authorized future contract.
The coadd-admission proﬁle is SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2. It is a MAP-authored, V AL-governed aggregate
proﬁle with separate request, applicability, eligibility, and realization axes, distinct from the ﬁve-stage MAP lifecycle.
The historical SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@1 remains immutable and is not an alias for this successor. It requires
compatible quantity and nominal-beam convention, PTC route/product role, response class, complete AST WCS/grid,
support policy, coeﬃcient family, covariance disclosure, null/additive-reference state, required companions, lifecycle,
and parentage. The coeﬃcient family is SCI-MAP:uniform_observation_coadd_coefficient@1: uop = 1 , dimensionless, on
every admitted observation row. It is an equal-observation coeﬃcient and has no inverse-variance interpretation.
Writing ˆmobs for the stacked signal on exact observation-row identities, Bout is the centered-integer averaging op-
erator. Tobs stacks compatible ﬁxed-state member response objects on the same domains, and Σobs contains every
available within- and cross-observation covariance block. SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1 permits unavailable or response-basis-
incompatible response without changing numerical signal membership, but then coadd response is unavailable with
exact cause; no smaller hidden membership or zero response is formed. SCI-MAP:response_bearing_coadd@1 parents the ex-
act base coadd with identical ordered members and requires every response object named by that role with compatible
source domain, basis, class, unit, normalization, parent, WCS/grid, and row identity. Missing a diﬀerent unselected
response family does not block it.
The equation Cc,out = BoutΣobsBT
out is a complete numerical covariance statement only when every block named
by SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1 is available on that exact base membership. Otherwise the coadd publishes
an explicitly partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or unavailable covariance state. Unknown blocks
remain unknown, not zero or independence. If an existing base parent lacks a required companion, the stronger role is
unavailable and never selects a subset. A separately requested stronger-role admission may reject an observation before
building its own explicitly identiﬁed base/signal parent. The denominator is normalization, not precision. Correlated
generalized least squares, which may need negative coeﬃcients and a full Σobs, belongs outside this positive-coeﬃcient
branch.

SCI-MAP v0.2 – Science-Team Rationale r0.2 CANDIDATE
7 Units, WCS, products, and downstream use
SCI-MAP receives its scale and unit convention only through the realized PTC product; there is no direct SCI-
CAL fallback. It preserves the coordinates, exact frame metadata, geometry, and coordinate validity supplied by
ALIGN/AST through SCI-AST:rtc_output_grid_coordinates@1 for the same stable RTC sample and parent chain. It
records the complete declared frame identity— including the actual reference system, equinox/epoch, time scale,
topology, WCS, axes, signs, and handedness—and does not replace it with “J2000. ” PTC owns transformed-sample
identity and availability, producer-local validity, and MAP-facing coeﬃcient/covariance facts. MAP owns the target
grid and its own projection, coeﬃcient-admission, boundary, support, and use conditions. V AL may represent and
evaluate named rules; it does not author those policies.
The full binary64 typed or sidecar WCS is the lossless identity used for admission, common-grid comparison, and
provenance. The WCS serialized in the FITS product is the representation ordinary scientiﬁc tools are expected to
use for pixel-to-sky conversion. For an immutable ﬁnite MAP grid of nx by ny cells, the 0.1-arcsec representation-test
population is the ﬁnite union of (a) every scientiﬁcally addressable integer pixel center (j + 1, k + 1) for 0 ≤ j < n x,
0 ≤ k < n y, and (b) every outer-footprint cell vertex: (h + 1
2 , 1
2 ), (h + 1
2 , n y + 1
2 ) for 0 ≤ h ≤ nx, together with
( 1
2 , l + 1
2 ) and (nx + 1
2 , l + 1
2 ) for 0 ≤ l ≤ ny. The second set includes all four outer corners and every required
outer-boundary vertex. The complete population is preregistered from the full-precision typed WCS, grid shape, and
row domain before the physical FITS WCS is generated. Both representations shall bind the same WCS-generation
identity, celestial frame, axis order, signs, handedness, orientation, shape, and centered-integer reference-pixel relation.
At every population member, each WCS is evaluated at the exactly corresponding center (zero-based memory index
(j, k ), one-based FITS pixel (j+1, k +1)). Separation is the great-circle angle atan2(∥u×v∥, u·v) between unit direction
vectors in that exact declared frame, evaluated with IEEE-754 binary64 round-to-nearest, ties-to-even operations and
reported in arcseconds. The maximum over the complete ﬁnite population shall be at most 0.1 arcsec. If either
WCS yields an invalid or non-ﬁnite direction at any preregistered member, the representation fails; the point is not
dropped. A center is absent only when its scientiﬁc row was already absent before population generation; every listed
outer-boundary vertex remains required. No smaller sampled subset or continuum/global-sky claim is authorized.
The bound is representation authority only; this rationale gives it no physical interpretation.
The FITS WCS is suﬃcient for ordinary pixel-to-sky use at its declared serialization ﬁdelity, while the sidecar retains
the exact WCS identity used for admission, conformance, provenance, and coadd comparison. A tolerance never
authorizes a diﬀerent sky grid, fractional shift, interpolation, or reprojection.

Downstream packages inherit the base/unﬁltered MAP unit, response, covariance, validity, WCS, and provenance.
SCI-NOI owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty, conditional-scale, and standardization methods
and products. Any physical- noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness, signiﬁcance, probability, false-rate,
completeness, purity, or catalogue interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains unavailable
by default. MAP therefore keeps Q normalization, formal conditional precision, complete conditional covariance, the
NOI conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment, the NOI standardized signal, and
any future calibrated-signiﬁcance method as distinct identities and claims. FLT owns ﬁltered response, covariance,
and validity while preserving that parent; source and Beammap packages own their scientiﬁc inference. Pointing and
Science-team circulation | CANDIDATE Page 12

SCI-MAP v0.2 – Science-Team Rationale r0.2 CANDIDATE
OOF may be registered consumers of the exact ordinary gridding operator when their inputs satisfy its contract, but
their mode WCS/frame, source model, ﬁtting, response interpretation, outputs, defaults, proﬁles, and qualiﬁcation
remain with their respective owners. No unsupplied mode proﬁle becomes available.
8 Validation
Validation must keep algebra, software conformance, representation ﬁdelity, observational performance, and produc-
tion readiness separate. The required science program is:
1. analytic estimator tests for constants, unequal coeﬃcients, and exact hand calculations;
2. exact one-hot half-open-boundary tests and explicit rejection of fractional projection until a successor family is
authorized;
3. support, boundary, global-population, and unsupported-pixel tests;
4. complete-bundle compatibility and centered-integer coadd placement tests;
5. sequential/parallel conformance: ﬂoating results agree within a preregistered bound appropriate to operation count
and conditioning, while identities, counts, masks, support, oﬀsets, and product cardinality agree exactly;
6. synthetic point, extended, gradient, edge, and variable-coverage response tests; and
7. observational amplitude, shape, position, covariance, and repeatability checks against independent references.
No test, implementation inspection, reduction, or production qualiﬁcation was executed for this authorship revision.
9 Scientiﬁc-owner decisions and remaining gates
The register in Appendix B preserves OD-001 through OD-009. All nine are decided for this successor candidate: eight
use the approved 2026-08-28 dispositions and OD-008 carries the earlier one-hot decision. PTC-OD-010 supplies the
versioned Registry architecture, and the separately approved uniform authority ﬁlls one exact family slot by reference.
No open scientiﬁc choice remains within this incorporation scope.
This is still a candidate. Complete successor disposition by the scientiﬁc owner, fresh implementation-blind consistency
review, exact ﬁnal source and V AL binding, and freeze remain pending. Further revision should follow a normative
discrepancy, owner disposition, new scientiﬁc evidence, or a demonstrated inconsistency rather than stylistic churn.

C Document authority
Rationale revision r0.2 presents the targeted SCI-MAP v0.2 successor candidate. The shared source preserves 52
canonical requirement IDs and 25 canonical prediction IDs while incorporating the approved post-freeze and uniform-
family decisions. The common modules are the normative authority; the formal and engineering documents are
conformant rendered views. Scientiﬁc- owner disposition, independent consistency review, canonical activation of the
supplied exact candidate source/V AL bindings, and freeze remain pending. No implementation, validation, availability,
readiness, or production claim follows.
